args.lesson: Preparation done in one EXEC plus a dry_run. The EXEC confirmed there was no prior key file and that the baseline says 'indexnow not submitted'. It added only a 32-hex key file and checked the existing files against the live-verified hashes (6/6). The dry_run digest is 6fa0e550... with 8 files and 17060 bytes, exactly 32 bytes more than the live version. Reusing the Ghost manifest shape kept the work bounded. Limits: nothing is deployed or submitted, and a future IndexNow 202 only means the request was received. The prior three IndexNow submissions produced no classified feedback, so treat this as low-value discovery hygiene and do not repeat it for new pages by default. Revenue still depends on a classified request plus operator Interac acceptance, or on Apify access.
